name: Desire & Decorum
source:
It's court or be courted when you learn you're one of the most eligible heiresses in England! Does true love await you at the grand Edgewater Estate?

[From [url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Desire_%26_Decorum,_Book_1]Choices Wikia[/url]]
translation:
当你得知自己是英格兰最炙手可热的女继承人之一时，是主动追求，还是等待别人求爱？真爱是否正在宏伟的埃奇沃特庄园等着你？

[摘自[url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Desire_%26_Decorum,_Book_1]Choices Wikia[/url]]
